definition: A Spire-level executive termination package so lavish it effectively functions as a second fortune — including full neural archive rights, offshore asset transfers, identity reseeding, and lifetime medical coverage — ensuring that even fired Tier 1 executives never face real consequences.
origin: Corporate HR jargon, Palladian Group compensation architecture
usage: Used bitterly by lower tiers and labor advocates; discussed matter-of-factly in Spire business culture
example: "They 'let him go' after the Meridian data breach scandal — but with apex severance, he was sipping real coffee in a Geneva arcology inside a week."
